meta.name: 2036 Origin Unknown
meta.description: After the first manned mission to Mars ends in a deadly crash, mission controller Mackenzie 'Mack' Wilson assists an artificial intelligence system, A.R.T.I. Their investigation uncovers a mysterious object under the surface of Mars that could change the future of our planet as we know it.
meta.slogan: The origins of our existence have remained a mystery...until now
